en.title: What Defiles Us? | Jesus Christ
en.description:
What truly defiles a person? It's not what goes in but what comes out. This powerful teaching from Jesus reveals the truth about our hearts and the source of our actions. In today's world, it's easy to blame external factors for our struggles, but Jesus challenges us to look within. 

Understanding the depth of this message can lead to profound personal transformation. Are we aware of the evil that can arise from within us? Reflect on your thoughts and actions today. What do you think is the key to purifying our hearts?

#Shorts #Christianity #Bible #Faith #Heart
en.first_comment: This quote from Jesus reminds us that the real battle lies within our hearts. It's a challenging truth, but recognizing our inner struggles is the first step toward transformation.
